alt: Cover: Priya holding a clipboard. Week 43, 19–25 October 2026: last week in one page — 10 stories, 5 facts, 2 likely MCQ angles.

Revision sheet for Week 43 listing 10 UPSC stories with GS paper and Prelims angle: SC on S.125A false affidavits; CEC removal under Article 324(5); UNEP Emissions Gap Report; CBD COP17 KMGBF review; SC on bail and pre-trial detention; India–New Zealand FTA in force; cyclone watch on the Andhra coast; Ladakh hill councils; ethanol feedstock shift to grain; DPDP breach-notification rule not yet in force.

Five facts: CEC removal like an SC judge; RP Act S.125A penalty up to 6 months; KMGBF has 23 targets including 30x30; BNSS S.479 bail after half (one-third for first-time offenders); UNEP Emissions Gap Report compares pledges with the Paris goals.

Two likely MCQ statements with answers: CEC removable by the President on Cabinet advice — False; damaged food grains can be used for ethanol under the National Policy on Biofuels — True. Every story with its UPSC angle: minimalistias.com/week.
